mapper.select: SELECT r.sch_id, r.project_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sport_activity_qzs_record r INNER JOIN sport_project p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE r.status = 1 GROUP BY r.sch_id, r.project_id

SELECT g.grade_name, r.project_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) AS user_cnt FROM sport_activity_qzs_record r LEFT JOIN sport_grade g ON g.id = r.grade_id WHERE r.sch_id = #{schId} GROUP BY g.grade_name, r.project_id
